email.description: How it goes by email: at once, in the daily or weekly digest (08:00 Singapore time, weekly on Mondays), or not at all. In the app it always shows.

etag.description: The preference in force: send it in If-Match to change it.

locked.description: true for security notices, which are always on and go by email as email says, whatever the caller chooses.

note.description: Why a locked type goes by email as it does, where that needs saying; absent otherwise.
examples: Every sign-in is emailed at once by the sign-in alert, so it is not emailed again here

recommended.description: How it goes by email unless the caller chooses otherwise.
